schema.title: Response Sessions Api V1 Auth Sessions Get

get.description: Whether the website may offer "Ring mig op nu", the calling hours and the public demo number.

post.description:
The website chat: a visitor writes freely to Peter, who answers from the sales workspace's approved
knowledge (the same knowledge the demo call uses). Nothing is stored about the visitor; every call is logged
as AI usage on the sales workspace.

get.description: A short sample of Peter's voice, so a visitor can hear who will ring. Rendered once, then served from cache.

patch.description: Idempotent: answers are merged. Step 2 looks the company up, step 4 fetches its website in the background.

post.description: Name, e-mail and mobile → an SMS code. The consent text is shown next to the box (GET /funnel/consent).

get.description: After verify, for the user the draft belongs to: the demo call's state (erhverv) or the private workspace.

post.description: The code → the account, the session (same shape as POST /auth/login plus `session_token`), and the build.

get.description: The six buttons of «Hvad laver I?» and the «hvornår tager I ikke telefonen» chips.
Suggestions for «Hvad hedder virksomheden?». Google data (or demo data without a key) – nothing is stored.
Provider redirect. Always ends in a redirect to the frontend, with `connected=<key>` or `error=<code>`.
Public preview for /invite/:token (A05). Reveals only what the invitee needs.
Traffic light + the few numbers that matter + the list of things that need attention.
Every discount code, newest first, with how often it was used.

post.description:
Make a code for Erhverv, Privat or both. Privat/begge codes are mirrored to Stripe (coupon + promotion code)
so Checkout can apply them.
Stop a code (also at Stripe). Customers who already redeemed it keep their discount.

Open a read-only session as this user. The raw token is returned once; the caller (the web BFF) keeps it in an
httpOnly cookie. Operators cannot be viewed (and a view-as session cannot start another one).

get.description: Paid B-income per private ambassador for the year – the basis for reporting to eIndkomst. Contains CPR.

put.description: Move a customer to another ambassador, or remove the attribution. Earned entries stay where they are.

post.description: CPR and bank details in clear text, for making a transfer or reporting. Every reveal is audited.

put.description: Change bonus, share and period. Applies to invoices paid from now on; earned entries are not touched.

get.description:
Visitors, page views, top pages, referrers and so on for dialogbot.dk from both sources. Each half says
whether it is configured; an unconfigured half is not an error, it just has no numbers yet.

schema.title: Response Website Api V1 Operator Analytics Website Get

get.description:
Newest activity first, with counts per status and per category (the counts ignore the status/category filter
so the page can show them as tabs).

The lead ledger (docs/sales/privat-revenue.md): per business, how often Privat users asked it for a quote through
Dialogbot and how often they chose it – the sales argument «we sent you N customers». Business side only.
CVR lookup incl. advertising protection, so the seller checks a company before ringing it.

post.description: Never contact this business again: block list (phone + CVR), and the stored address and consent are dropped.
One fixed mail (email_templates.intro_mail) through the normal outbox. Only to an address given with an explicit yes, once.

get.description: Status (what works, what is missing) and the overview tiles. Works in every mode, also `off`.
A signed URL (≤ 10 min) to the recording. Playing is logged; exporting also needs `can_export_media`.

post.description: Fallback without Google: the operator's own list, marked `import`.
Record a manual check of advertising protection (when CVR system access is not set up). Audited.
Research the company's own website in the background (only through the safe fetcher).
A simulated conversation (no call, no tool executed). Marked simulated everywhere.
Register the documented basis for contacting this person (e.g. they asked to be called). Audited.
Run the contact policy now (no campaign) and store the decision.

get.description: The sales workspace's approved knowledge with audience, the price list and the script versions in use.

post.description: A link the customer asked for on a call, to an address we did not hold: the operator has checked it.
The operator's own choice of channel and destination (checked by them): sent at once.

Queue a search. The worker runs it; the answer carries the estimated Google usage (upper bound).
`dry_run=true` returns the plan and estimate without saving anything (a free-text place that is not a Danish
town or postal district is geocoded with one Places request even then).
An internal test call to a number in SALES_TEST_NUMBERS (SALES_OUTBOUND_MODE=test or live). Real telephony.

get.description: Provider, which platforms are connected, the schedule and counts per platform and status.

One call for the operator page: followers per platform (today + curve + 7/30-day change), posts waiting for
approval, scheduled, recently published with engagement, and failed.

post.description:
"Generér nye opslag": fresh drafts on top of the daily plan, for any day/topic/platforms, even when the day
already has posts. They wait for approval like every other draft.
Read today's profile numbers and the engagement of recent posts from the platforms right now.
Create the missing posts now (for one day and topic, or for the whole planning window).

Post immediately (may take up to a minute while Instagram processes the images). For a failed post, check the
profile first: after an 'uncertain' error the post may already be out.

get.description: Companies in Dialogbot's industries with their Facebook/Instagram/TikTok links, newest batch first.

post.description: Make a batch now (the worker makes one every morning by itself). Needs CVR access; answers 501 without it.
The operator followed/commented from Dialogbot's profiles — record it so the company is never suggested again.

Body: {profiles: [ids], cases: "alle" | [ids], mode, workspace_id?}. Runs every chosen case through every chosen
profile in real time, one stream per profile at a time. 202 + the run ids; poll GET /runs.

Body: {profile, case, mode: controlled|natural, workspace_id?}. 202 + run id; poll GET /runs/{id}.
A profile without access is recorded as `mangler_adgang` (with what is missing) rather than failing the request.
Replay an uploaded 16-bit WAV (not stored) against a typed reference text. Result is stored, audio is not.

get.description: The raw audio Vapi sent at the start of the most recent bridged call, as a WAV an operator can listen to.

post.description:
Run a WAV (mono or stereo, 8/16 kHz 16-bit) through the bridge's Speechmatics session without a phone call and
return the segments. Stereo takes channel 0, like the bridge. `fixture` names a known recording from
tests/fixtures/linden (Peter's voice, known text) instead of an upload. The offline test of Danish recognition.

Point a number's incoming calls at Vapi (and so at our assistant, voice and transcriber): Twilio's voice
webhook back to Vapi's inbound URL, and the Vapi number's server URL to our webhook. Undoes what importing the
same number into another engine (ElevenLabs Agents) did to the Twilio webhook. Platform credentials only.
Map a number that already exists in Dialogbot's Vapi org (e.g. migrating a hand-set-up customer).
A person's review outcome. The API records who and when; it never infers a verdict.
Test clip of any version (also drafts) for review. Not cached.
Upload one reference WAV (body = raw bytes). Stored privately under the voice's own scope.
Create (idempotently) the caller's personal workspace: owner membership, no business rows, 3 welcome credits.

delete.description:
Delete what a switched-off app has saved (409 addon_enabled while it is on; 409 not_deletable for apps whose
things are lists and tasks). Cannot be undone.

post.description: Data is kept; shared lists I own are paused (members cannot open them; invite links stop working).
Generic invitation for any shareable add-on (same link, landing page and referral reward).
«Giv mig besked»: remembered on the account (a «Kommer snart» app).

put.description: «Trin 2 af 3»: how far the user got in the app's setup (shown on Mine apps and Min dag until it is done).

delete.description: Removes the time from the user's calendars. It does NOT cancel anything at the business.

get.description: One appointment as a calendar file («Tilføj til kalender»).

post.description: The raw image as the request body (image/jpeg, png, webp, heic; ≤ 6 MB). Only apps with photos (Garanti).

get.description:
{summary, items: [{id, text, sub, share_text?}], partner: {name, url, text, note} | null}. A partner is always
an advertisement (note: «Annonce …»).
Every bill by next due date, plus this month's overview (total of the known amounts).

post.description: Adds the birthday, or changes the date of the person with the same name.

get.description:
Everything the app needs on load and after an action, in ONE request: before this the web made eleven
(me, day, tasks ×2, messages, ledger, addons, referrals, groups, subscription), each paying for its own
session lookup and the Frankfurt↔database round trips – about a second of pure waiting after every message.

At most 3 businesses (Google Places; demo data without a key). 30 searches per user per hour (429).
Show «Data fra Google» with results whose source is "google".
The Kalender app's state: the subscription link (only whether it exists), Google/Outlook and upcoming times.

delete.description: Revokes the access at the provider (best effort) and deletes the stored credentials.

post.description: Where to send the user to give access to Google Calendar or Outlook. They come back to /privat/kalender.
A new secret subscription link. It is shown this once; the previous link stops working.

Stripe Checkout (mode=payment): 10 credits, 29 kr. incl. moms (or the currency's price, markets.PRIVAT_CREDIT_PACK).
Credits arrive with the webhook.

get.description: Without Supabase (dev/test) files.sign() returns local:// links; the web maps them here. Never in prod/staging.
Public: group name, owner's first name, member COUNT. Never names or numbers. Rate limited per IP.

post.description:
Login optional. Without login: name, and a number only after an SMS code (first call: code_sent; then again
with `code`). Max 50 new members per link per hour.

delete.description: Deletes the group and every number in it.

post.description: «Byg gruppen selv»: ONE link the owner posts in an existing group chat from their own phone.

get.description:
Public (no login): the short link /i/{code}. Same preview as by token; nothing personal beyond first name.
Rate limited per IP, misses (unknown codes) much more strictly (429 rate_limited).

Public (no login): title, owner's first name, list type, item COUNT, share mode, and the Dialogbot card.
Rate limited per IP (429 rate_limited).

post.description: Join (creates the private account if needed). Returns the shared Task (or {} for a non-list invite).

patch.description: What the assistant is called in the app and the chat (calls and e-mails still say «Dialogbot»).
Only what the user gives (city, postcode or the browser's position); used to find businesses near them.

post.description: «Opdater nu»: ask the tracking service again (at most every 10 minutes per parcel).
Sends «Det virker – du får besked her» to every subscription of the caller.

«Inviter venner»: a link to Dialogbot itself, with the same short link and suggested SMS text. ONE link per user:
while it is valid for at least another week the same one comes back (Konto made a new invitation on every visit).
Pilot: a simulated, voluntary sponsor spot (max 2 a day) activates one draft task.

get.description:
The trial / plan and this month's call quota. With ?session_id= (back from Stripe Checkout) the session is read
from Stripe first, so the page is right before the webhook lands. `currency` and `plans` are in the customer's
currency if it has one, else ?currency=, else DKK.

parameters.description: DKK, SEK, NOK eller EUR: planernes priser for en kunde uden valuta endnu (en kunde beholder sin)
parameters.name: currency

schema.description: DKK, SEK, NOK eller EUR: planernes priser for en kunde uden valuta endnu (en kunde beholder sin)
schema.title: Currency

post.description: Stripe Checkout (mode=subscription). The plan becomes active through the webhook / the return sync.
Stripe Billing Portal: change plan, cancel, update card. 501 not_configured without Stripe or a customer.

get.description: The latest run for the task, without internal selectors; evidence links are signed and expire after minutes.

put.description: «Gem design». design null = «Nulstil til tema» saved: only the look changes, never the wishes or members.

post.description: Upload a cover (raw image body). Not applied until «Gem design» sends its key.

put.description: Join or change my pledge. Refused above what is left (409 pledge_exceeds_remaining, remaining_minor).

post.description: An invitation link the user sends from their OWN phone (suggested_text). Dialogbot sends nothing.
People already on Dialogbot join in-app; the rest get SMS texts the user sends from their OWN phone.
Real prices from the configured providers, cheapest first, within the total budget. Nothing is booked.
The owner's own photo for a wish (raw JPEG/PNG/WebP body, ≤ 6 MB). Returns image_key for the wish form.

«Indsæt link»: what the shop's page declares (title, image, price + currency, shop, variants), for the owner to
check. `readable: false` keeps the link so the wish can still be saved by hand. Nothing is saved on the list.

get.description:
«Søg efter produkt»: real product pages (web search + each page's own structured data). 503 search_unavailable
when web search is not configured – then the web offers «Indsæt link» / «Opret selv». 30 a hour (429).
Terms and rules shown on the sign-up page (the quiz without the answers).
What an ambassador's personal page shows. Only active ambassadors; first name only.

post.description: Count one visit (per day, aggregated). Unknown refs are ignored silently.

get.description: Secret, read-only iCal feed of the workspace's bookings for the owner's own calendar app.
Booking types and free times for the chat widget. Empty when booking is off.
Time windows the visitor can choose for a call back, in the business's local time.

post.description: "Bliv kontaktet": the visitor leaves contact details; creates the conversation's lead and a follow-up task.
ElevenLabs Agents conversation-initiation webhook (trial engine): the call's prompt, greeting and voice.
ElevenLabs Agents post-call webhook: store the call like a Vapi end-of-call report.
ElevenLabs Agents server tool: run one action (free times, booking, SMS …) for the number's workspace.
Resend delivery events. Public, but every request must carry a valid Svix signature.
Stripe events (card saved, invoice finalized/paid/failed). Every request must be signed.

post.description:
One turn: an answer with a link, a question, a change shown as before → after (nothing is saved before «Godkend»)
or a wish recorded for Dialogbot's team. Anyone in the workspace may ask; a change needs the role it needs.

get.description:
Read model for the assistant: only approved, current knowledge.
The AI conversation itself is not implemented in this stage.

post.description:
Ask the assistant one question, answered only from approved knowledge. Internal test tool:
nothing is sent to a customer. 501 when no AI provider is configured; 409 without approved knowledge.

get.description:
Card, billing e-mail and the market: country, currency (locked once there is an agreement), VAT number and the
VAT the invoices carry ({kind: domestic|reverse_charge|outside_eu|vat_number_required, rate_bp, country, note}).

post.description: Stripe Checkout (setup mode): the owner saves a card at Stripe. Nothing is charged now.

get.description: The discount code this workspace uses (if any): the code, its terms and the months it covers.

put.description: The owner types a discount code. One per workspace; it counts from the current month's statement.

post.description: Invoice a month now (normally the worker does it after the month closes). Idempotent per month.

get.description: Preview of what the month would cost under the agreement. Not an invoice; nothing is charged.

put.description:
The company's VAT number (normalised; it must fit the company's country – EL for Greece). Empty clears it. An EU
company outside Denmark is invoiced without VAT (reverse charge) only with one. The Stripe customer's tax id
follows it.

get.description: Default: from yesterday to `days` ahead. With `start` (and `end`, inclusive) the local calendar days in between instead.

post.description:
A staff member confirms a booking «afventer bekræftelse» (made while the connected calendar could not be read).
It is then written to the calendar through the shared mirror path; a write failure shows as «Ikke i kalenderen».

delete.description: Delete the audio now (the transcript stays). Vapi is asked to delete its copy too.

get.description:
A short-lived link to the call's audio (10 minutes). Whoever may read the transcript may listen; each play or
download is logged.

post.description: The only way a campaign starts calling. Payment never starts calls.

get.description: «Opkald og beskeder»: phone and webchat in one list with a derived outcome. f = all | to_you | booked | done | webchat.

post.description: Hand the conversation back to the assistant (ai) or take it over without writing yet (staff).
A colleague answers the visitor in the chat. Takes the conversation over from the assistant.
«Marker som klaret»: closes the open tasks of the conversation's lead and gives a taken-over chat back to the assistant.

get.description: Name and address from the CVR register, for the owner to accept into the profile. Nothing is saved.

post.description: Any staff member can block a number (someone asked not to be called); only admins can unblock.
AI proposal for conversation goals and channels. Nothing is saved; the owner edits and saves.
A person tries an action from the settings page (channel 'test'); it is logged like any other.

delete.description: Remove an item (archived, kept in the audit trail). Approved items need owner/admin.

delete.description: Consent withdrawn: recordings deleted, the voice stops at once (next calls use the fallback voice).

get.description: The workspace's Dialogbot numbers (provisioned by Dialogbot; customers never add provider numbers).

get.description: Channel status and the last 7 days at a glance.

post.description:
Runs every server-side check. Checks needing an unimplemented capability
are reported as skipped with the reason; they are never recorded.

get.description: G01/G02/G05/G08 in one server-computed document: tasks, next action, checks, resume state.

put.description: G07: hand a task to a colleague who is a member of this workspace.
Changing a campaign's voice never starts, pauses or re-prices it.

post.description: A short sample of a ready-made phone voice, so a customer can hear it before choosing it.
A short Danish sample as WAV. Own text is limited, counted and never cached or logged.
New widget key: the old embed code stops working immediately.

get.description: Real readiness: database reachable and migrations at head.
